subject: general
question: In what time will ₹8,000 become ₹9,261 at 5% per annum, compounded annually?
solution:
Formula:

A = P × (1 + Rover 100)T

where-

P = Principal

R = Rate

T = Time

A = Amount

Calculated:

Substituting the values given, we get-

⇒ ₹9,261 = ₹8,000 × (1 + 5over 100)T

⇒ 9261over8000 = (21over 20)T

⇒ (21over 20)3 = (21over 20)T

∴ T = 3 years

∴ The time period is 3 years.
